title-group.article-title: Developing a Fully Glycosylated Full-Length SARS-CoV-2 Spike Protein Model in a Viral Membrane

sec.title: System construction
sec.p: Starting from PDB 6VSB and 6VXX, full-length spike protein structures were constructed. The fully glycosylated spike model was placed in a viral membrane.

sec.title: Molecular dynamics workflow
sec.p: The reported preparation workflow adds missing residues, glycans, membrane, water and ions before energy minimisation, equilibration and production molecular dynamics.
